description: Frontend statelessness verified — no on-disk or in-memory state outside ephemeral UI concerns (cursor, scroll position). All harness→frontend communication is filesystem; all frontend→harness communication is 'lernie <subcommand>' exec. No banned terms. Pluggability: documented enumerated paths + CLI surface, demonstrated by a smoke-test second frontend (even a trivial one) running concurrently without corruption.
title: Gate: alignment (v0.5 UI epic)
